svg.aria-label: dsh-reach structure: a two-sided decision bridge. On the left, the DSH host emits approval/request, user-questions/request, session/event and reach_send; the top lane captures the card, renders P-number plus #token, queues it per user under a send budget, and adapterFor(chatId) delivers it to one of six IM channels on the right. The reply crosses the fail-closed security gate, the decision parser chooses a target card, and the held promise is settled; the pending ledger in the middle holds the deferred card while it waits, with timeout and dispose exits.
svg.title: dsh-reach: one card, one round trip across the host/IM boundary
